claims.label: EXACT GRAPH FACT
claims.statement: The internal-vertex gauge action on the 16 edge weights has rank 8, so its integer monomial invariant lattice has rank 8.

claims.label: EXACT GRAPH FACT
claims.statement: The natural invariant flow space decomposes into three closed-cycle directions and five independent boundary-to-boundary path directions. The full closed-cycle rank is 16-14+1=3.

claims.label: EXACT CANCELLATION THEOREM
claims.statement: For any closed-cycle exponent vector q, every discrete-holomorphic vertex factor cancels exactly from the protected primitive, leaving the signed graph-weight monomial. The retained basis yields -6/7, -4/21, and 18/175.
claims.authority: independent MATHCERT exact C05 primitive replay

claims.label: EXACT QUOTIENT FACT
claims.statement: The five boundary paths plus three cycles form a complete integer invariant basis. Their positive weight monomials are related to the WP01 coordinates by an integer 8x8 matrix with determinant -1 and an exact integer inverse.

claims.label: EXACT OBSTRUCTION
claims.statement: The five boundary-path geometry products retain endpoint boundary factors beta_i. Hence the closed-cycle cancellation route alone recovers only three independent quotient directions from geometry increments without additional boundary calibration.
claims.scope: This is an obstruction for the exact monomial cancellation route, not a universal impossibility theorem for every conceivable geometry inversion.

claims.label: CONDITIONAL EXACT RECONSTRUCTION
claims.statement: When the certified algebraic-branch boundary factors beta_i are supplied, the five path products normalize to the remaining five signed weight invariants, and the full eight-dimensional quotient is reconstructed through the exact unimodular chart.

claims.label: NUMERICAL REPLAY
claims.statement: Across all five retained generated C05 branches, the three raw cycle products agree with their exact targets to maximum absolute error 2.19e-14. The five raw path products vary by branch, but after branch boundary normalization agree with targets to maximum absolute error 6.91e-13.
claims.scope: Numerical replay supports the exact identities; it is not itself the exact proof.

claims.label: RESEARCH DISPOSITION
claims.statement: The supported terminal disposition is CYCLE_INVARIANT_QUOTIENT_RECONSTRUCTION_PARTIAL: three quotient directions are geometry-only cycle invariants; all eight are recoverable only with branch boundary calibration.

claims.label: CLAIM BOUNDARY
claims.statement: WP05 does not establish VGSE-C06, Figure-16-to-pinned-C source correspondence, physical stiffness, mechanical advantage, rigid foldability, collision freedom, finite thickness, material response, manufacturability, tolerance or fatigue performance, product performance, novelty, priority, patentability, or commercial value.
